bureau: credit bureaus licensed under the Fair Credit Reporting Act
note: The Central Bank of Barbados: under the Fair Credit Reporting Act a credit bureau may keep information about a person's credit seven years after the debt is paid. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Central Bank of Barbados, Credit reporting: your questions answered
sources.said: According to the Fair Credit Reporting Act, credit bureaus can retain information about your credit activity for seven years after you have paid off the loan or other debt.
